tables.title: Character rules
rows: See the Roster tab's 'Pick order' and Warrior talent tree for the class-skill order.
Make the first character a Warrior; for talent priorities, see the Roster tab's 'Pick order'.
The main pushes; the alt farms lower zones for cards, materials, gold and Hunter levels.
When the second slot opens is unverified: EvitaniaOnlineDB's beginner guide says you start with 2 slots, its classes page says it opens after the first boss; check in game.
Have at least one Warrior and one Rogue in the roster.
See the Roster tab's 'Pick order' and 'Pusher' for damage and utility talent priorities.
See the Roster tab's 'Warrior' for the late nodes to skip.

Before each Act 2 boss, check kills per hour on your main in the boss's zone. Aim for: Yeti zone about 500 (Ice Mammoth), Troll zone about 1,000 (Jötunn), Draugr zone over 1,000 and about 1,300 physical defence (Maevath). If you are short, raise Hunter trainings and sacrifices first.
Troll map, the red portal. After the first hand falls he summons monsters that explode for over 3,000 damage, possibly an instant kill. Kill each one before anything else.
When the eyes glow, run from under the hand to the far side of the map, starting near the screen edge. You should take at most one tick; most characters survive 4–5 full beams.

Stand under a hand to bait a punch, step out as it lands and hit the hand. Go behind the hand for the side slap and leave the middle for the ice breath. Once both hands are gone his HP drains by itself.
Hand drops are random, so the fight is long and mostly waiting: about 10 minutes, with 12 beams and over 20 slaps. A Mage's lightning can hit the body instead of the hand.

Disputed. One player in the Discord guide reports the Mammoth Ring (+100 magic defence) cut Jötunn's eye beam from over 600 a hit to about 100, but a Steam player thinks the beam scales with physical defence, and EvitaniaOnlineDB lists the ring's magic defence as +10. The ring's attack speed and crit damage hold either way.
Hunter, sacrifices, cards, Curio and the stash are account-wide; levels and talents are per character.
Unlocked by killing the Act 1 last boss. Since 0.321.0 it gives +50 Drop Quantity and +50% EXP and gold for giving up the other slots.
Alts are still stronger, so Lone Wolf is optional.

No class is best all game. Warrior is easiest early and online but is the only class with a move-speed penalty in the offline formula; Rogue is the best offline farmer until Hunter and sacrifices are high; Mage is best online and offline once you farm at the kill cap.
STR, DEX and INT each give +10% attack to their class. CON gives +5% HP and +1% HP regen; MEN gives +5% MP, +1% MP regen and +5% magic defence.
Final stat = sum of flat x sum of percent x product of multipliers, so true multipliers (x1.5) are worth the most late.
Tower at level 25, Engineer at 40, event dungeons and the Halloween quest chain at 50, guilds at 60 (registered account), presets at 70 and Act 2 Hard at combat level 80.
A monster's hit falls to chip damage of 0 once your Defence is at or above its Attack. Compare with the monster tables below.
Step back 3–4 steps from the frontal leap. In the poison gas, leave the marked zone and kill the flower shooters in the corners.
Back away from the chomp, then return. Keep walking to break the root. Below 30% HP its armour and shield counterattacks are gone.

Wait until he lands, then stand inside him under the chin: hits drop from 200–400 to about 99 and the sweep and breath miss. When he flies, go to the stairs and climb once the flames are out. Iron gear is enough.

Stay on the hitbox for the flame stamp. Run back or sideways when it rears up. Break one ground crystal to stun the stampede, and use an active ice crystal to interrupt the howl. The frontal stomp and an unstunned stampede can kill outright.

Stand close to dodge the claws and breath cone; when he inhales, run to the far left or right. When he flies, kill the Draugrs quickly so the stairs appear, or he stays airborne and the lower floor fills with flames. In stage 2 use the green safe zone and kill adds fast. Keep potions for the last phase.

Step out of the tentacle slam and return. When the worm comes swirling from the right, run to the left corner. It spawns mini worms underground: kill them all, go back up on the left side, and repeat.
The Obelisk's Hard difficulty multiplies base material drops by 16. Act 1 Hard has no listed requirement beyond reaching the Act 3 Obelisk.

tables.title: Classes
rows: The usual first character and the easiest talent tree. Class skills unlock in the order Warrior, Rogue, Mage. The talent tree here has Defence as 7 nodes with 35 ranks; the wiki data has 35 ranks over 6 nodes (unverified until checked in game).
Good late game. No bonus EXP nodes, so slower to level, but more Drop Quantity than a Warrior.
Area attacks; unlock class skills first, including the 100% crit skill. The talent tree here gives Bonus XP 15 ranks; the wiki data gives 25 over "Nodes 1–2" (unverified until checked in game).
Maps with 3 or more spawn platforms, such as Crabs
